claims.head: The matchup inside the matchup
claims.body: The Capitals are one of the league’s best for chance quality, and the Kraken are near the top of the league at preventing dangerous shots. Our lean: the Capitals’ chance quality wins out.
claims.call: The Capitals’ chances are more dangerous than the league average (a 6.3% chance of scoring on the average shot) against the Kraken.
claims.nums: Washington 4th for chance quality (a 6.7% chance of scoring on the average shot) · Seattle 6th for preventing dangerous shots
claims.gist: It’s strength against strength: the Capitals for chance quality, the Kraken at preventing dangerous shots.

claims.head: The Capitals’ edge in shots from in close
claims.body: The Capitals are near the top of the league for shots from in close, and the Kraken are around the middle of the league. It’s the widest gap between these two.
claims.nums: Shots from in close: Washington 7th, Seattle 22nd
claims.gist: The Capitals have the edge over the Kraken on shots from in close.
claims.call: The Capitals take a bigger share of their shots from within 20 feet than the Kraken.

story.head: The matchup inside the matchup
paras: The Capitals have won two in a row. The Kraken are 3-2-0.
It’s strength against strength: the Capitals for chance quality, the Kraken at preventing dangerous shots. The Capitals have the edge over the Kraken on shots from in close.

items.text: Jordan Kyrou has seven goals in nine games against Seattle since 2023-24, most of them with St. Louis.
Bobby McMann has four goals in six games against Washington since 2023-24, most of them with Toronto.
Matt Roy has missed the Capitals’ last two games.
Alex Ovechkin is still looking for his first goal of the season.
